Question 11
?

The ratio of boys to the total number of children in a birthday party is 4:7. What is the meaning of this ratio?

a
Out of every 7 children at the birthday party, 4 of them are boys
b
The birthday party has exactly 7 children
c
The birthday party has exactly 4 boys
d
The birthday party has exactly 11 children
e
Out of every 4 children at the birthday party, 7 of them are boys
